Jute Bag Factory is a **jute bag manufacturing and supply business** in **India** with customers nationwide. Since **2002** it has served brands, event agencies, and institutions that need repeatable quality on **large and repeat** orders.

**Custom printed jute bags** — totes, conference bags, wine bags, jar bags, pouches, file folders — for **corporate gifting**, **events**, **dealer meets**, and **wholesale** channels across India.

### Where are you based?

Our registered office and showroom is at **WZ-572 K, 2nd Floor, Naraina Vihar, New Delhi - 110028, India**. Visits by appointment. We dispatch bulk orders pan-India and export internationally through FIEO & EPCH channels.

## Company profile

Founded in 2002, Jute Bag Factory manufactures, exports, and supplies a wide range of jute bags: branding and exhibition, events and conferences, wine and jar styles, totes, goodie bags, grow bags, pouches, and more. Our **India** team coordinates large collections across designs, colours, and finishes. We use quality raw material and strong process control for durable, presentable products shipped at scale—ideal when your brand is on every bag in the room.

Design focus

Scale does not have to look cheap. We build bags that stay presentable when your **brand is on the move**—and after the event, when they are still in use.

Typical B2B ask: **durability** \+ print that survives real handling, not just the photoshoot.

## Common questions (quick)

The same topics are also marked up for search; more detail is on the [full FAQ](https://jutebagfactory.in/faqs.html) page. Tap a row to expand—no page reload.

1What is Jute Bag Factory?

Jute Bag Factory is an **India** jute bag manufacturer and supplier, with a registered base you can visit by appointment. Since 2002 it has supplied **jute bags in bulk** for business, export, and institutional use, with emphasis on **custom print** and **repeat** programs.

2Do you supply custom printed jute bags for corporate and gifting in bulk?

Yes. Bulk, corporate, and **gifting** orders are the main focus. Share quantity, design intent, and delivery city via [this form](https://jutebagfactory.in/#quote) or [contact](https://jutebagfactory.in/contact.html) so the team can advise on print options and schedule.

3Where is your office and how do visits work?

The address is **WZ-572 K, 2nd Floor, Naraina Vihar, New Delhi - 110028, India**. Appointments and sample reviews are usually arranged after an initial [inquiry](https://jutebagfactory.in/contact.html) so the right range is kept ready for your team.

4How do I get a price for a large order?

Use the [quote block](https://jutebagfactory.in/#quote) at the top, or open any product in the [grid below](https://jutebagfactory.in/#catalog) and send a quick inquiry with the line item selected. Add approximate **quantity** and **timeline** for a meaningful reply.

5I only need one or two bags. Is that possible?

Small quantities or samples may be possible depending on availability; priority remains **volume and custom print** jobs. State your need clearly in the [inquiry](https://jutebagfactory.in/#quote) so the team can suggest the most practical path.
